title: Elon Musk appears to signal the end of the road for Cybertruck

title_en: Musk Signals End of the Road for Cybertruck

summary_zh: 马斯克似乎暗示Cybertruck即将停产，称需要腾出产能用于生产无人驾驶出租车Cybercab。

title: Three men charged in US with using AI to impersonate CEOs and steal millions
summary: Men allegedly impersonated voices and images of executives to convince employees to send large payments Three foreign nationals were arrested and charged with using AI to allegedly impersonate corporate CEOs and attorneys to steal over $100m, according to an indictment that was newly unsealed by the US Department of Justice. According to a press release from the United States attorney’s office for the southern district of New York, three men – Jacob Soall, Sharon Hazan, and Guy Sheetrit – were arrested for using AI to alter and impersonate the voices and images of executives and attorneys at various companies in order to convince employees to send over large payments. Soall and Hazan were arrested in Spain over the summer, while Sheetrit was arrested in the United Kingdom in September. The alleged fraud took place between 2024 and 2026. Continue reading...
title_en: Three Men Charged in US with Using AI to Impersonate CEOs and Steal Millions
title_zh: 美国起诉三名男子利用AI冒充CEO诈骗数百万美元
summary_en: Three foreign nationals were charged in the US with using AI to impersonate CEOs and attorneys, allegedly defrauding companies of over $100m between 2024 and 2026. Two were arrested in Spain and one in the UK.
summary_zh: 三名外籍男子被美国起诉，涉嫌利用AI冒充企业高管和律师，在2024至2026年间诈骗超过1亿美元。两人在西班牙被捕，一人在英国被捕。

title: Global stocks fall amid ‘big worries over AI’ after Democrats’ midterms triumph
summary: Asian and European markets follow US tech rout with many analysts predicting more waves of selling to come European and Asian stock markets fell sharply on Friday after the Democrats’ decisive victory in the midterms triggered a rout in US tech stocks a day earlier. A sell-off on Wall Street on Thursday was followed by sharp falls in Asian stock markets on Friday. The investor sentiment then reached London, where the market was, at one stage, poised for its worst day since March. Continue reading...
title_en: Global Stocks Fall Amid 'Big Worries Over AI' After Democrats' Midterms Triumph
title_zh: 民主党中期选举大胜后，全球股市因“AI重大担忧”下跌
summary_en: Asian and European markets fell sharply after Democrats' midterm victory triggered a US tech rout, with analysts predicting more selling to come as AI concerns weigh on investors.
summary_zh: 民主党中期选举大胜引发美国科技股暴跌，亚欧市场随之大幅下挫，分析师预计AI担忧将导致更多抛售。

title: Several Democrats renew calls for datacenter pauses after blue wave
summary: Tech industry fears delays to its multi-trillion dollar infrastructure buildout meant to power artificial intelligence Several newly elected Democrats and Senator Bernie Sanders have renewed calls for datacenter moratoriums in the days after the US midterm elections. The sweeping Democratic victory , which was buoyed in part by backlash to the tech industry , has added momentum to efforts to slow down the multi-trillion-dollar buildout of the controversial facilities. On the social media platform X, Sanders posted a call for an immediate national datacenter moratorium this week. “Americans don’t want Big Tech oligarchs wrecking the environment, gutting jobs and threatening humanity’s future,” Sanders said on Wednesday. Continue reading...
title_en: Democrats Renew Calls for Datacenter Moratoriums After Midterm Wins
title_zh: 中期选举获胜后民主党人再次呼吁暂停数据中心建设
summary_en: Newly elected Democrats and Bernie Sanders are pushing for datacenter moratoriums after midterm victories, citing environmental and job concerns, adding momentum to efforts to slow the multi-trillion-dollar AI infrastructure buildout.
summary_zh: 中期选举大胜后，新当选民主党人和桑德斯再次呼吁暂停数据中心建设，担忧环境与就业问题，为放缓数万亿美元AI基础设施建设增添动力。

title: AI stocks climb after trillions wiped from market values

summary_zh: 投资者因担心民主党胜选将放缓AI发展而抛售科技股，导致数万亿美元市值蒸发，随后AI相关股票反弹回升。

summary: Fears of more AI regulation appear to have sparked fear among investors, but concerns about the industry have been growing for some time.

title_zh: 美国中期选举引发AI监管担忧，AI股票遭抛售

title: How a Blue Wave midterm might reshape the AI industry

The public voted on 41 data center-related ballot measures on Tuesday — in all but one, the majority voted to impose more restrictions on data center development. And even when data centers weren’t on the ballot directly, they were a […]

title_zh: 中期选举“蓝色浪潮”或重塑AI产业

summary_zh: 民主党中期选举大胜或改变科技业格局，41项数据中心相关公投中40项通过限制措施，显示公众对AI基础设施扩张的反对情绪上升。

title: The Guardian view on the AI backlash: American voters want a say in their future | Editorial
summary: The tech sell-off exposes fragile promises, while Democratic victories offer a chance to protect workers and hold firms accountable This week’s midterms showed that the political bill for the AI boom is falling due. The Democratic sweep intensified fears over runaway spending, mounting debt and resistance to datacentres, sending tech shares tumbling. On Thursday Wall Street suffered its worst day since the pandemic as $3.2tn was wiped from markets. Anthropic, developer of the Claude chatbot, is hoping to float within the next fortnight for $1.5tn (£1.1tn), but it may not now get even a trillion dollars. The dominant AI chipmaker Nvidia saw its value crash by more than $400bn. The world’s richest man, Elon Musk, lost $113bn in two days . While a few very rich people may be a little less wealthy, the sell-off may not be a bad thing. It brings a needed dose of reality to an industry whose spending plans and valuations depend on heroic expectations of future profits. That is a view held by many influential figures – from Goldman Sachs’ research boss to Nobel laureate Daron Acemoğlu . AI may transform the economy. That does not guarantee investors will earn back the sums being poured into it. Do you have an opinion on the issues raised in this article? If you would like to submit a response of up to 300 words by email to be considered for publication in our letters section, please click here . Continue reading...
title_en: Guardian View on AI Backlash: Voters Want a Say in Their Future
title_zh: 《卫报》评AI反弹：美国选民希望对自己的未来有发言权
summary_en: Midterm Democratic wins and a $3.2tn tech sell-off signal political and market pushback against the AI boom, as voters demand accountability and investors confront inflated valuations.
summary_zh: 中期选举民主党大胜与科技股3.2万亿美元抛售，显示AI热潮遭遇政治与市场双重反弹，选民要求问责，投资者直面虚高估值。

title: US tech stocks post modest recovery on Wall Street after worst day in 19 months – as it happened
summary: European and Asia-Pacific markets slide after Wall Street rout, while latest US jobs report beats forecasts Could the AI bubble burst after Democrats’ midterms sweep? - The Latest Despite the sharp losses suffered on global stock markets around the world, most indices are still up for the year. The Nasdaq Composite index, for example, is still up 4.6% since the start of January – even though it’s more than 10% below its peak. “The tech sell-off has intensified, with the pain of the brutal sell-off on Wall Street carried straight through to Asia and knocking sentiment in Europe. Big worries are colliding – the build-out of data centres looks set to slow, which risks shredding the spending spree underpinning the boom, right at the time that investors have become super nervous about returns on this massive investment. Continue reading...

Data centers were a major bipartisan issue ahead […]

title: Activists break into building site of Microsoft datacentre in Amsterdam

Protesters from Geef Tegengas, a Dutch direct action group, clashed with police while breaking into a construction site at Westpoort, Amsterdam, where some members climbed a crane, lit flares and tied helium balloons to equipment. Continue reading...
